plugins.name: aify-project-graph
plugins.description: Local APG code graph, briefs, packets, dashboard, and optional code-intel import for agentic coding.

pi-linux.notes: Base APG works on low-resource Linux/ARM. Optional C++ code-intel requires compile_commands.json and clangd. pi-linux is the oh-my-pi (omp) runtime.

hermes.notes: MCP-capable Hermes agent runtime. Install doc gives both an mcp-CLI form and a JSON-config fallback; the MCP server stanza is runtime-agnostic.

cursor.notes: Cursor IDE MCP integration. Install writes ~/.cursor/mcp.json + optional .cursor/rules/aify-graph.mdc. Plan #17 E mirror of codegraph's cursor support.
